# Magellan Flights

> The cheapest flights from the USA, tracked like a market - every day.

Magellan Flights tracks the cheapest flights from the USA every day, like a stock market, so travelers book at the low. Every fare is real and links to booking.

## Key pages
- [Cheap Flights from the USA — Tracked Daily](https://www.magellanflights.com/): Find today's cheapest flights from the USA to anywhere. Real fares refreshed several times a day and tracked like a stock market, so you book at the low. Round-trip and one-way deals.
- [Cheap Flight Deals Today — Live Fare Tracker](https://www.magellanflights.com/market.html): A live board of the cheapest one-way flights from the USA, with price history and how far below normal each fare is. Updated daily.
- [Cheap One-Way Flights from the USA (Next 6 Months)](https://www.magellanflights.com/explore.html): The cheapest one-way flights from the USA over the next six months. Filter by region and home airport to find your next trip for less.
- [Cheapest Around-the-World Flights — Build Your Loop](https://www.magellanflights.com/around-the-world.html): Build the cheapest around-the-world trip from live one-way fares: set your start, stops, regions and direction (east or west). Real, bookable fares, refreshed daily.
- [Cheap Flights by Departure City — Live Deals](https://www.magellanflights.com/cheap-flights.html): Find the cheapest flights from your home airport. Live, bookable fares from 25 major US cities to everywhere they fly, updated daily.
- [The Cheap Flight Index — Cheapest Places to Fly from the USA](https://www.magellanflights.com/cheap-flight-index.html): A live data study of the cheapest real fares from US airports right now: cheapest international destinations, cheapest US airports to fly abroad from, and how far below normal today's deals are. Updated daily, free to cite.
- [Weekly Flight-Market Briefing — Free Newsletter](https://www.magellanflights.com/newsletter.html): The free weekly flight-market briefing: how each country's fares moved, what's below normal now, and one trip to book this week — from fares tracked daily. Unsubscribe anytime.
- [Cheap Last-Minute Flights from the USA](https://www.magellanflights.com/lastminute.html): Today's cheapest last-minute flights from the USA, domestic and international. Real, bookable fares for travelers who can leave soon.
- [Cheap Flights from Your Home Airport](https://www.magellanflights.com/airports.html): See the cheapest flights leaving your home airport right now. Pick your airports and track fares to everywhere they fly.
- [Flight Deal Guides — When to Book & Where to Go](https://www.magellanflights.com/guides.html): Straight answers on when to book flights, the cheapest time to fly, and how to catch a cheap fare — backed by fares we track daily.

## Guides
- [The cheapest day to book flights](https://www.magellanflights.com/cheapest-day-to-book-flights.html): The cheapest day to book flights is usually Tuesday or Wednesday - but your booking window matters more. Here's what thousands of live fares actually show.
- [When to book international flights](https://www.magellanflights.com/when-to-book-international-flights.html): Book international flights too early and you overpay; too late and prices spike. The sweet spot is wider than you think — here's exactly when to buy.
- [The cheapest time to fly to Europe](https://www.magellanflights.com/cheapest-time-to-fly-to-europe.html): The cheapest time to fly to Europe from the USA is the off-season — roughly mid-January to March and November to mid-December. Here's how to save the most.
- [Are last-minute flights cheaper?](https://www.magellanflights.com/are-last-minute-flights-cheaper.html): Usually no — last-minute flights are typically more expensive, not cheaper. But there are specific cases where waiting pays off. Here's the honest answer.
- [How to find cheap flights](https://www.magellanflights.com/how-to-find-cheap-flights.html): Nine tricks that actually work for finding cheap flights — the right booking window, flexible dates, fare alerts, and spotting fares below their normal price.
- [What is a mistake fare?](https://www.magellanflights.com/what-is-a-mistake-fare.html): A mistake fare is a flight priced far below normal because of an airline error. They're real and bookable — but rare, fleeting, and not always honored. Here's how they work.
- [How to finance a trip without the debt trap](https://www.magellanflights.com/how-to-finance-a-trip.html): Buy-now-pay-later and travel loans can spread the cost of a trip - but they can also quietly cost you hundreds. Here's how travel financing really works, when it makes sense, and how to do it without paying interest.
